mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT ut.tenant_id AS tenantId, u.id AS id, u.user_name AS username, u.name, u.email AS email, u.phone_number AS phon FROM whale_user_tenants ut JOIN whale_users u ON ut.user_id = u.id WHERE ut.is_deleted = 0 AND u.is_deleted = 0
AND ut.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
SELECT r.name FROM whale_user_roles ur JOIN whale_roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{id} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO whale_user_tenants (id, user_id, tenant_id, created_at, created_by, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{tenantId}, NOW(), #{createdBy}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_deleted = 0, deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = NULL, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}
